name: Tiny Eye
architecture: stem: conv 2x2 stride 2 (1->w0) + LayerNorm over channels; stage i>0 starts with LayerNorm + conv 2x2 stride 2 (padding 1 when the grid is odd: 14->7->4); each block: depthwise 7x7 conv (padding 3) -> LayerNorm -> fc1 -> GELU (erf) -> fc2 -> times gamma -> add to the block input; head: mean over the grid -> LayerNorm -> linear. LayerNorm eps 1e-5. Conv weights are [out, in/groups, kh, kw]; Linear weights are [out, in].
neurons: fc1 outputs (before GELU) of each block; a drawing's value for a neuron is its mean over the grid.
input: 28x28 grayscale, row-major, ink = 1.0 and paper = 0.0 (bitmap / 255). In the Quick, Draw! bitmaps the drawing is scaled so its longer side spans 26 pixels (a 1-pixel margin), centered on the shorter side, with soft anti-aliased strokes about 2 pixels wide (about 27% of pixels have ink).

stories.title: a roof that grows an umbrella offshoot
stories.text: From about step 600 it is a house-roof neuron. Later umbrellas, a peaked top too, join it: by the end they are about a fifth of its top 100 doodles, just below the houses.

stories.title: castle walls, then fish
stories.text: It starts on castle walls, then switches to fish between steps 1,206 and 2,387, when the eye is already right 78 to 84 times in 100.

stories.title: vehicles, then arches, then houses
stories.text: Vehicles and puffy animals at first, then arches and rainbows (all rainbows at step 3,359, when the eye is 85% right), and houses at the end.
